title: House Oversight calls on DOJ to interview key Epstein witnesses, says govt. ‘failed’ survivors
summary_full: "The federal government has failed the survivors of Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell's horrific crimes for decades," Rep. James Comer, R-Ky., said.
